steps.title: Solution
steps.text: \[\begin{aligned}&f(1)=6\Rightarrow c(1)^{2}+d=6\\[5pt]&c+d=6\ldots \text{ (i)}\\[5pt]&f(-2)=10\Rightarrow c(-2)^{2}+d=10\\[5pt]&4c+d=10\ldots \text{ (ii)}\\[5pt]&\text{Subtract (i) from (ii): }3c=4\\[5pt]&\therefore c=\frac{4}{3}\\[5pt]&\text{Put }c=\frac{4}{3}\text{ in (i): }d=6-\frac{4}{3}\\[5pt]&\therefore d=\frac{14}{3}\\[5pt]&\therefore \text{ }\textcolor{#047857}{\mathbf{c=\frac{4}{3},d=\frac{14}{3}}}\\[5pt]&\quad \text{(Check: }\frac{4}{3}+\frac{14}{3}=6\text{ $\;\checkmark$; }\frac{16}{3}+\frac{14}{3}=10\text{ $\;\checkmark$)}\end{aligned}\]
